name: RankJet AI-Powered SEO & Growth Architect
author: wpdive

sections.description:
RankJet AI is a powerful platform for SEO optimization. This plugin connects your WordPress site to your RankJet account, enabling:

  • Cloud Integration: Automatically sync your content with RankJet.
  • AI-Powered SEO: Generate meta titles, descriptions, and keywords directly from the platform.
  • Content Analysis: Get real-time scoring and suggestions.
  • Centralized Management: Manage SEO for multiple sites from one dashboard.

Note: A RankJet AI account is required to use this plugin.

External Services

This plugin connects to the RankJet AI Platform to synchronize content and retrieve SEO data.

  • Service: RankJet AI
  • Data Sent: Post content, titles, and existing SEO meta data.
  • Purpose: To analyze content and generate SEO suggestions using RankJet’s AI models.
  • Terms of Service: https://rankjet.ai/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://rankjet.ai/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload rankjet-ai.zip to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to RankJet.ai > Integration in your WordPress admin.
  4. Enter your RankJet API Token to connect your site.
